editorial.blurb: Beatrix is a warm, stylish cafe-restaurant where thoughtfully sourced ingredients shine in both comforting breakfast dishes and creative dinner plates, with standout service that feels genuinely welcoming.
editorial.insiderTip: Go early for breakfast — the baked oatmeal and avocado toast are reviewers' favorites — or visit late evening for coffee and pastries; they can accommodate gluten-free and dairy-free diets if you ask ahead.
